quest.title: As Though Kissed by Dew
quest.description: I know that sweet dreams are as fleeting as the morning dew. And yet...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, Leafy Dreams x1

chapter.num: Enchanted Tales of the Mikawa Festival: After-Night
chapter.title: As Though Kissed by Dew

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ah, compadre! A little birdie told me you went to Aisa Bathhouse last night!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I'm gettin' the crew together, and we're gonna go there to celebrate! You in?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, we were just there...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Uh, yeah... But, I bet you were missin' a few people, yeah? Like Shinobu.. and Gorou... and, y'know... Ayato...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Basically, Boss heard about the trip, and now he really wants to go.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: A—Anyway! Once you're done perusin', come find me, and we'll SOAK! IT! UP!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ready!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Aww yeah! Next stop, Aisa Bathhouse!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Following Itto's constant nagging, you all head to Aisa Bathhouse once again...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha! This has gotta be the hottest one! Let's see who can last the longest! Who's in?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hehe, if you're that excited about it, how can I refuse?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Listen... This isn't a sauna...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ahhh... so warm... *snore*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, don't fall asleep in the tub!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Uh... My fur is so heavy. I almost feel dizzy...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha! If you can't handle the heat, Gorou, get out of the... tub!

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara
dialogues.text: Hey! Stop being so loud!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: On the other side...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Heh, Itto is as energetic as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It's not good to get distracted during a match, brother.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Whoa! This game is getting heated! What's your next move, {NICKNAME}? What do you two think?

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Hm... I would take it slow, try to consolidate my advantage.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Or, you could be aggressive... taking a risk isn't a bad idea!

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: #Oh? Very clever, {NICKNAME}! A decisive defeat... I concede! Now, based on the random draw earlier, the next player should be...

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: #Oh, uh... Okay! Go easy on me, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Ayato must have lost to me on purpose to give Ayaka more time to play... Always up to something, that one...)

dialogues.speaker: Aikawa Susumu
dialogues.text: Boss! The Mikawa Flower Festival was a huge success for us! We had three times more visitors than usual!

dialogues.speaker: Aikawa Susumu
dialogues.text: Based on what we've made so far, I think we'll be able to make... this much!

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: That's great news! We might even beat Yae Publishing house this month...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Oh? You look pleased about something... Having a party without me?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: Oh, hehe... It's nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: I forgot to share some good news with you...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Thirty percent of the proceeds from the festival have been transferred to Yae Publishing House. We're expecting record profit this month... Don't you think congratulations are in order?

dialogues.speaker: Yumemizuki Mizuki
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Aikawa Susumu
dialogues.text: W—Well, boss... I guess congratulations ARE in order... This is our 333rd time competing against Yae Publishing House in sales, and our best showing to date — second place!

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: ...May this be a night of sweet dreams for all.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Well? Ready to get your soak on?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a sec...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, compadre... Don't tell me the gaming bug's gotcha bad, like Akira and the others... I mean, the games are fun, but they'll still be there after a good soak!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Oh, you didn't go to the hot springs?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well now, I don't see you going either...

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: ...We did go with the Boss, once. But then he got it into his head to start some sort of competition...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What sort of competition?

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: Um, I forgot. The only thing I remember is almost passing out from the heat...
